work_unit: Local account registration, session UI, and safe auth redirects

evidence.uncertainty: The existing application supports only a server-configured bootstrap identity; registration and redirect behavior need new explicit contracts.
evidence.scope: The change spans PostgreSQL identity storage, a migration, API contracts, JWT issuance, frontend session state, and App Router pages.
evidence.reasoning: Credentials must be hashed, usernames must be unique, registration races must be safe, sessions revocable, and redirects limited to local paths.
evidence.verification: Security-focused backend tests, migration checks, frontend static checks, build, and a provider-free local integration flow are required.

workers.scope: PostgreSQL credential persistence, account API, JWT integration, migration, and security-focused tests.
Memory-only App Router session state, sign-in/sign-up/sign-out pages, safe local redirects, and auth UI integration.

coordinator_work: Inspected the combined database, API, JWT, client-session, and redirect contracts.
Corrected Alembic online configuration so normal local migration commands read the ignored root .env without exposing its database URL.
Applied and verified migration 20260920_0003 in the configured local PostgreSQL database.
Allowed an enabled registration-only local profile to omit bootstrap credentials while retaining bootstrap support when configured.

passed: Focused offline backend registration, authentication, session, foundation, and migration tests: 47 passed.
Worker-reported full backend suite: 271 passed, with only existing TestClient deprecation warnings.
Ruff for backend app/tests and strict mypy for backend app.
Frontend ESLint, Prettier, Next type generation/TypeScript, and production build, including /login, /signup, and /logout routes.
Local Alembic upgrade to revision 20260920_0003 and PostgreSQL inspection verifying local_credentials exists.
Live provider-free sign-up, sign-in, durable session revocation, and cleanup of a disposable local account.
not_run: A live browser registration/login/logout walkthrough: it requires enabling matching ignored backend and frontend local registration settings.

limitations: Local accounts are development-only and are rejected in production.
They do not provide email verification, password recovery, rate limits, audit records, or public account administration.
